map.均质坝 Dupuit 渗流（本页代码口径）：单宽渗流量 q=K×H²÷(2×L): Homogeneous-earth-dam Dupuit seepage (as implemented on this page): unit-width seepage discharge q = K×H²÷(2×L) (m³/(d·m); H upstream water depth in m, L seepage path length / dam base width in m, K permeability in m/d), converted to L/(s·m) as q×1000÷86400; phreatic line y(x) = H×√(1−x÷L), with heights reported at x = 0.25L, 0.5L, 0.75L and L; average seepage gradient i = H÷L. Validation: H, L and K are all required and must be greater than 0 (L is a divisor); otherwise the tool stops with a message. Criteria: i ≤ 0.1 is generally safe; 0.1 < i ≤ 0.25 requires filter and drainage measures; i > 0.25 means high piping / soil-boiling risk and dedicated seepage-control and filter verification (critical gradient of cohesive soil ≈ 0.5–1.0, for preliminary judgment only).
